meta.title: Baptiste Gosselin, infrastructure, code and theater
meta.description: Computer science student in Caen, France, apprentice at Deepthought Solutions. I design highly available cloud platforms on Kubernetes, I write code, and I do theater.

hero.stageDirection: The curtain rises. A ghost light was left on, network cables trail across the stage.
hero.line: Hello. I'm Baptiste. I study computer science in Caen, France, and I take care of what nobody sees: infrastructure. I design highly available cloud platforms on Kubernetes, I run networks down to BGP with UnxWares' own AS218888, and I write code. When the servers run on their own, I go on stage.
hero.status: He is an apprentice at Deepthought Solutions for the 2026-2027 season.

items.title: Cloud platform architect
items.text: Designing highly available platforms end to end, from the network to deployment, and keeping them standing over time. That's what I did at Traktion and what I do at Deepthought Solutions; I want to make it my job.

items.title: Carrier-grade networking
items.text: With UnxWares, I obtained AS218888 and I announce our own IPv6 space over BGP. I want to go further on the network side, where infrastructure really starts.

items.title: Research and development
items.text: Research, prototype, measure, then ship to production. R&D at Deepthought Solutions gave me a taste for it, and I want to keep going that way.
